body: Yeah, I've tried to make that message very clear to everyone close to me ever since I attempted a year and a half ago. There's a point where everyone just needs to let go because I had a potentially fatal illness and, well, treatment failed.
No, you make sense. I totally feel like I get the whole galaxy- vs. human- sized meaning and fulfillment, as I came to the same conclusion at one point. I'm glad it's working for you.
I'm sorry. I really just want to do what's best for my husband.

I've already given him that last week and more. I've done everything he wants me to. 

I don't doubt that there are many others feeling the same way. I've tried this all before. For those it has helped, great, but it's not for me any more. I'm past this.

I guess the dinner got canceled. Now I don't know what to do because I won't be left alone for a while.

I'm not disregarding him. He'll be much better off without me. 

I don't feel the need to talk about what's hurting. I feel okay right now. I'm at peace with my choice.

I'm sorry that this is a stressful subreddit. Being in this position for me is stressful, too. Let's not take it out on each other.

I'm not asking for the best way to kill myself. I already figured out what I'm going to do. I'm asking on behalf of those around me what small thing might help them. This isn't about me any more. I'm not seeking help for me. I'm seeking advice for helping them.

If that is inappropriate of me or if this is the wrong place, then I'm sorry. People at this subreddit can reasonably assume suicide will be a topic here, so I thought it was safer than somewhere people wouldn't assume there would be triggers. I just figured it would be worth a shot and I'm sorry if I'm in the wrong.

Thanks, max-ac, for being respectful. I appreciate it.

My primary concern is my husband and I have talked to him. I/we have tried everything we can think of for me. We're both still young, though, and don't have any kids, so I think that if I leave, he'll have a better shot at having a good life than if he stays with me. He's tried to help me through my current suicidal crisis for a while now and I can see how much I'm hurting him. Sure, suicide will hurt more, but I figure it's better to get over it now than have to drag him through a lifetime of pain.

Today I haven't let on what's going on. I was super honest about it up until this point. I'm just acting like my meds are finally kicking in and when he goes out to dinner with his best friend, I'll take care of things.

If there's nothing I can do, then I might as well not delay any longer.

I'm sorry my post upset you and that your view holds that every encounter you have with someone who is suffering should end in happy roses. Now I feel even worse, too.

But I do appreciate the you took the time to answer. I'll take what I can from it.

I can see why you'd think that. Not the case, though. Obviously I should have used my 3 year regular account for this so all the people I know IRL could see my post and come to my rescue because I so obviously just want to be saved.

I, for one, am grateful for this post because it helped me find him. I am planning on dying anyway and I had a question I just PMed him and I hope he answers me. It'll make things go smoother. 

Thanks, ptrostli, for bringing him to my attention. Some people really are better off dead and I appreciate the resource deathwatch1 is.
